demography._note: WDI has no Gini for Cambodia; 0.36 is DECLARED (order of CSES-based estimates). Simulation starts in 1979, when schools reopened after the Khmer Rouge period: earlier cohorts have no schooling history in the model.

NY.GDP.PCAP.KD.why: WDI constant-dollar GDP per head falls from 845 (1993) to 514 (1994), a series break, not a 39% collapse. Values before 1994 are dropped and the 1994 value is held flat backwards (DECLARED).

structure._note: 6+3+3 from 1994 (MoEYS; 5+3+3 in 1987-94 is not modelled). Late entry up to age 12 at 15% a year of the never-entered (DECLARED) because overage entry is a defining feature of the Cambodian series.

catch_up_entry._note: Post-conflict reopening: never-entered children up to 14 enter at 35% a year (DECLARED). Produces the 1980s overage bulge; not fitted.

repetition._note: DECLARED, order of MoEYS rates in the 2000s.

costs_share_of_gdppc._note: DECLARED. Includes informal fees (about 8.7% of family income per child in 2007, NEP via UNDP), materials and forgone earnings. Public HEIs charge fees in Cambodia.

policy_events.what: Priority Action Program: registration and other start-of-year fees abolished in primary and lower secondary, replaced by school operating grants (SY2000/01).
Priority Action Program, lower secondary fee abolition.

transfers.what: Lower secondary scholarships for poor students (PAP 12 and JFPR, 13,938 recipients in 2003-04 rising to 25,872 in 2007-08).

tertiary_entry_exam._note: Grade 12 national exam (Bac II) first-sitting pass rates, press reports of MoEYS figures (see facts.md). 2014 uses the post-resit 40.67. 2020: exam cancelled, all passed. Before 2012 DECLARED 80.

tertiary_public_capacity._note: Fixed before any Cambodian fit: the supply rule preferred in the Philippine test (PROTOCOL A5).

income_gradient_2010._note: DHS 2010 Table 2.5 quintile net attendance, from sources/demand_costs.md. Quintile ratio used as registered gradient proxy.

income_gradient_2012._note: CSES 2012, UNICEF/MoEYS/UIS out-of-school study 2016. QUINTILES, ages 12-14 net attendance in lower secondary. Direction and rough size only.

v5._note: Inputs used only by engine5. DECLARED unless a source is given.

direct_costs_share_of_gdppc._note: Anchored to CSES 2019/20 average annual education expenses per pupil by level (thousand riel: primary 651, lower secondary 1,142, upper secondary 2,272, tertiary 5,548; sources/demand_costs.json) divided by GDP per head (~6.8 million riel in 2019, WDI current US$ x ~4,050 riel/$). Public/private split DECLARED (private about 3x for basic levels).

policy_events.what: Priority Action Program: start-of-year fees abolished; informal fees persist (Bray).

fixed_params._why: No household-spending target in the 1995-2010 training window; the cost schedule is in data units (CSES).
